verses.text: Di word of di Lord wey come to Zephaniah, di pikin of Cushi, di pikin of Gedaliah, di pikin of Amariah, di pikin of Hezekiah, for di days of Josiah, di pikin of Amon, king of Judah.
“I go sweep away everything completely from di surface of di earth,” na so di Lord talk.
“I go sweep away man and animal. I go sweep away di birds of di sky, di fish of di sea, and di stumbling blocks with di wicked; and I go cut off man from di surface of di earth,” na so di Lord talk.

“I go stretch out my hand against Judah, and against all di people wey dey live for Jerusalem; and I go cut off di remnant of Baal from dis place, and di name of di idolatrous priests with di priests;”
“And dem wey dey worship di army of di sky for di housetops; and dem wey dey worship and swear to di Lord and dey swear by Malcam;”
“And dem wey don turn back from following di Lord; and dem wey no seek di Lord, and no inquire about am.”
Keep quiet before di Lord God; because di day of di Lord don near, because di Lord don prepare sacrifice. E don consecrate im guests.
“E go happen for di day of di Lord sacrifice, say I go punish di princes, and di king sons, and all dem wey wear foreign clothes.”
“For dat day I go punish all dem wey jump over di threshold, wey dey fill dem oga house with violence and deceit.”
“For dat day,” na so di Lord talk, “noise of cry go dey from di Fish Gate, and wailing from di second quarter, and big crashing from di hills.”
“Wail, una wey dey live for Maktesh, because all di people of Canaan don finish! All dem wey load with silver don cut off.”
“E go happen for dat time, say I go search Jerusalem with lamps; and I go punish di men wey settle for dem lees, wey dey talk for dem heart say, ‘Di Lord no go do good, and e no go do evil.’”
“Dem wealth go become plunder, and dem houses desolation. Yes, dem go build houses, but dem no go live inside dem. Dem go plant vineyards, but dem no go drink dem wine.”
Di great day of di Lord dey near. E dey near and e dey hurry fast, di sound of di day of di Lord. Di mighty man dey cry bitterly for dat place.
Dat day na day of wrath, day of trouble and distress, day of desolation and destruction, day of darkness and gloom, day of clouds and thick darkness,
Day of trumpet and alarm, against di fortified cities, and against di high battlements.
“I go bring distress on men, so that dem go walk like blind men, because dem don sin against di Lord; and dem blood go pour out like dust, and dem flesh like dung.”

Dem silver no go fit save dem, and dem gold no go fit save dem, for di day of di Lord wrath; but di whole land go dey devoured by di fire of im jealousy; because e go make end, yes, terrible end, of all dem wey dey live for di land.
Gather together, yes, gather together, you nation wey no get shame,
Before di decree take effect, before di day pass like chaff, before di fierce anger of di Lord come on you, before di day of di Lord anger come on you.
Seek di Lord, all una humble people of di land, wey don keep im ordinances. Seek righteousness. Seek humility. E fit be say dem go hide una for di day of di Lord anger.
Because Gaza go dey forsaken, and Ashkelon go be desolation. Dem go drive out Ashdod for noon, and dem go root up Ekron.

Woe dey for di people wey dey live for di sea coast, di nation of di Cherethites! Di word of di Lord dey against you, Canaan, di land of di Philistines. I go destroy you, so that no inhabitant go remain.
Di sea coast go be pastures, with caves for shepherds and folds for flocks.

Di coast go belong to di remnant of di house of Judah. Dem go find pasture for dem flocks for dat place. For di houses of Ashkelon, dem go lie down for evening; because di Lord dem God go visit dem, and restore dem.
“I don hear di reproach of Moab, and di insults of Ammon pikin dem, wey dem use reproach my people, and make demself big against dem border.”

“So as I dey live,” na so di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, talk, “surely Moab go be like Sodom, and Ammon pikin dem like Gomorrah, possession of nettles, and salt pits, and perpetual desolation. Di remnant of my people go plunder dem, and di survivors of my nation go inherit dem.”
Dis na wetin dem go get for dem pride, because dem don reproach and make demself big against di people of di Lord of Armies.
Di Lord go dey awesome to dem, because e go starve all di gods of di earth; and men go worship am, everyone from im place, even all di shores of di nations.
You Cushites too, my sword go kill una.
E go stretch out im hand against di north, and destroy Assyria, and make Nineveh desolation, as dry as di wilderness.

Herds go lie down inside am, all kinds of animals. Both di pelican and di porcupine go lodge for im capitals. Dem calls go echo through di windows. Desolation go dey for di thresholds, because e don lay bare di cedar work.

Dis na di joyful city wey dey live careless, wey talk say for im heart, “I dey, and nobody dey except me.” See how e don become desolation, place for animals to lie down inside! Everybody wey pass by am go hiss, and shake dem fists.
Woe dey for di one wey dey rebellious and polluted, di oppressing city!
E no obey di voice. E no receive correction. E no trust di Lord. E no draw near to im God.
Im princes wey dey inside am na roaring lions. Im judges na evening wolves. Dem no dey leave anything reach di next day.
Im prophets na arrogant and treacherous people. Im priests don profane di sanctuary. Dem don do violence to di law.
Di Lord, wey dey inside am, na righteous one. E no go do wrong. Every morning e dey bring im justice to light. E no dey fail, but di unjust no know shame.
“I don cut off nations. Dem battlements dey desolate. I don make dem streets waste, so that nobody dey pass by. Dem cities don destroy, so that no man dey, so that no inhabitant dey.”
“I talk say, ‘Only fear me. Receive correction; so that im dwelling no go cut off, according to all wey I don appoint about am.’ But dem rise early and corrupt all dem doings.”

“So wait for me,” na so di Lord talk, “until di day wey I rise up to di prey, because my determination na to gather di nations, so that I go assemble di kingdoms, to pour my fury on dem, even all my fierce anger; because all di earth go dey devoured with di fire of my jealousy.”
“Because den I go purify di lips of di peoples, so that dem all go call on di name of di Lord, to serve am shoulder to shoulder.”
“From beyond di rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even di daughter of my dispersed people, go bring my offering.”

“For dat day you no go dey ashamed for all your doings, wey you transgress against me; because den I go take away from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you no go dey haughty again for my holy mountain.”
“But I go leave among you people wey suffer and poor, and dem go take refuge for di name of di Lord.”
“Di remnant of Israel no go do iniquity, and no go speak lies; and dem no go find deceitful tongue inside dem mouth; because dem go feed and lie down, and nobody go make dem afraid.”
Sing, Zion daughter! Shout, Israel! Dey glad and rejoice with all your heart, Jerusalem daughter.
Di Lord don take away your judgments. E don throw out your enemy. Di King of Israel, di Lord, dey among you. You no go fear evil again.
For dat day, dem go talk say to Jerusalem, “No fear, Zion. No make your hands weak.”
“Di Lord your God dey among you, mighty one wey go save. E go rejoice over you with joy. E go calm you with im love. E go rejoice over you with singing.”
“I go gather dem wey dey sorrowful for di appointed feasts. Dem na your own. Di reproach of am na burden on dem.”

“Look, for dat time I go deal with all dem wey dey afflict you; and I go save di lame ones, and gather di ones wey dem don drive away; and I go give dem praise and renown, dem wey shame don dey for all di earth.”

“For dat time I go bring you in, and for dat time I go gather you; because I go give you renown and praise among all di peoples of di earth, when I bring back your captivity before your eyes,” na so di Lord talk.
